$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH -- EDIT THIS FILE (for how the specification documents are split into files).

The requirements document 01-04-requirements.md and the design document 05-07-design.md are each split into part files of about 100 KB (plan B9, ANMS v0.36 'Splitting the specification'). The two old names stay the names of the whole documents: sentences of the specification and comments of src and tests still cite them, and a reader asks for a whole document by that name.

A whole document is its parts joined in the order below. The first part is read whole. A later part opens with its own StrictDoc header (title, Grammar, UID), repeats the headings of the sections it continues, and names the first part on the marker line; its body is everything after the marker line and the blank line that follows it. The bodies joined are the old file byte for byte.
startsAt is the heading line the body of a part opens with; tools/spec_files.py --split cuts a whole document there, and --check fails when a part's header is not the one this file implies.
Readers: tools/spec_files.py (Python) and tests/spec-files.ts (TypeScript). Check: python tools/spec_files.py --check (check.sh).
